scope: 42 V7 concepts; official public Printful catalog; US target region; no account/API variant inventory checked

status_meanings.candidate: No primary mismatch found in reviewed facts; sample and configuration still required
status_meanings.blocked: Specific missing match or unresolved design change; comparison facts are not production specs

cap.name: Classic Dad Hat | Yupoong 6245CM
cap.material: 100% chino cotton twill for the reviewed solid colors
cap.fit: Unstructured, low-profile, 6-panel; curved visor; adjustable buckle
cap.dimensions: Head circumference A: 20.5–24.375 in (52.07–61.91 cm, converted). Raw supplier diagram B / C / D: 4.75 / 3.125 / 7.5 in; do not rename these dimensions without the diagram.
cap.care: Hand wash with mild detergent in lukewarm water; no bleach or brushes; do not machine wash.
cap.notes: Public size guide inspected in browser, US destination, 2026-10-15. A is the head-fit range; one size is not a guarantee of universal fit.

mens-polo.name: Men’s Premium Polo Shirt | Port Authority K500
mens-polo.fit: Relaxed cut; supplier says runs large; flat-knit collar/cuffs, side vents, metal buttons with matching plastic rims
mens-polo.care: Cold gentle wash inside out with mild detergent; cool-air tumble drying; iron on reverse between cloths without steaming the embroidery. Final garment label and decorated sample must be checked.

chart.tolerance: Supplier garment tolerance: up to 2 in (5 cm).
chart.method: Length: high point shoulder to hem. Width: flat across chest, not circumference. Sleeve: center-back collar, over shoulder to sleeve hem. Body chest values are a separate supplier Measure yourself chart, not twice garment width.

womens-polo.name: Women’s Pique Polo Shirt | Gildan 64800L
womens-polo.material: 100% ring-spun cotton for White; Sport Grey is 90% cotton / 10% polyester; 5.2 oz/yd² (176 g/m²)
womens-polo.fit: Women’s semi-fitted, side-seamed; matching buttons; White may appear off-white
womens-polo.care: Cold gentle wash inside out with mild detergent; cool-air tumble drying; iron on reverse between cloths without steaming the embroidery. Final garment label and decorated sample must be checked.

chart.tolerance: Supplier garment tolerance: up to 2 in (5 cm).
chart.method: Product measurements transcribed from public Size guide. The rendered guide omitted the A/B/C diagram definitions during this audit; keep original labels and confirm diagram before shopper publication. Not a body measurement chart.

quarter-zip.name: Unisex Quarter Zip Pullover | Sport-Tek ST357
quarter-zip.fit: Regular fit, cadet collar, open cuffs/hem, matching zipper
quarter-zip.technique: DTFlex front / back; embroidery not listed
quarter-zip.care: No final care assigned: this printed blank does not match the approved embroidery technique.
quarter-zip.notes: Rejected as an embroidery match. Comfort Colors 1580 was also reviewed and lists DTFlex, not embroidery. Do not attach either chart to the approved design.

vest.name: No matching quilted vest located in reviewed Printful catalog
vest.notes: Reviewed jackets/vests category, Columbia 212488 fleece vest and knitted V-neck vest. Neither preserves the approved quilted construction. This is a search finding, not a claim that Printful can never supply one.

adult-hoodie.name: Unisex Heavy Blend Hoodie | Gildan 18500
adult-hoodie.fit: Adult unisex regular fit; lined hood with drawcord, pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs/waist
adult-hoodie.technique: Left / center chest embroidery; printing also offered
adult-hoodie.care: Cold gentle wash inside out with mild detergent; cool-air tumble drying; iron on reverse between cloths without steaming the embroidery. Final garment label and decorated sample must be checked.

chart.tolerance: Supplier garment tolerance: up to 2 in (5 cm).
chart.method: Length from high point shoulder to hem; width flat across chest; sleeve from center-back collar over shoulder to hem. Not body circumference.

adult-hoodie.notes: Color list here records relevant reviewed candidates only, not every available color. Forest Green #222E1F; Sand #e7d3b3. Color/size inventory not checked. Women’s design requires approval of the unisex cut.

youth-hoodie.name: Youth Heavy Blend Hoodie | Gildan 18500B
youth-hoodie.fit: Youth regular fit; lined hood, no drawcords, pouch pocket
youth-hoodie.care: Cold gentle wash inside out with mild detergent; cool-air tumble drying; iron on reverse between cloths without steaming the embroidery. Final garment label and decorated sample must be checked.

chart.tolerance: Supplier garment tolerance: up to 2 in (5 cm).
chart.method: Length from high point shoulder; width underarm seam to seam. Supplier text describes sleeve from top of set-in sleeve, but published values appear inconsistent with that method. Confirm sleeve method with Printful before shopper use. Do not replace with an adult chart.

youth-hoodie.notes: Forest green was not offered in the reviewed public US selector. SOL’S 03576 was also found as an alternative youth model but no green match was verified.

mug.name: White Glossy Mug — comparison only
mug.dimensions: 11 oz: height 3.8 in / 9.6 cm, diameter 3.2 in / 8.2 cm. 15 oz: 4.7 in / 11.9 cm × diameter 3.3 in / 8.5 cm. 20 oz: 4.3 in / 10.9 cm × diameter 3.7 in / 9.3 cm. Supplier’s published conversions retained.
mug.care: This comparison blank is dishwasher and microwave safe; do not apply that promise to an unresolved colored blank.
mug.notes: A printed background does not create a solid colored handle/interior. Final capacity must be selected; do not infer capacity from the approved photos.

bottle.name: Stainless Steel Water Bottle — comparison only
bottle.material: High-grade stainless steel; double-wall vacuum flask
bottle.fit: Bowling-pin silhouette; glossy finish, leak-proof cap
bottle.dimensions: Supplier size: 17 oz (500 ml), 10.5 × 2.85 in (27 × 7 cm); supplier-rounded metric values retained.
bottle.care: Hand wash only; not dishwasher safe.
bottle.notes: Approved designs require matte cream / forest green. Glossy black/white comparison is not a match; a wrap print cannot be assumed to change finish, cap or full-body color.

journal.name: Hardcover Journal Matte
journal.material: Matte laminated covers; white uncoated lined paper, 150 pages / 75 sheets; page weight 104 g/m²
journal.fit: Casewrap binding with flexible sewn spine; perforated pages
journal.dimensions: 5.75 × 8 in (14.61 × 20.32 cm in details; description rounds to 14.6 × 20.3 cm). Weight 330 g. Back barcode 0.5 × 0.5 in (1.27 × 1.27 cm).
journal.care: No journal-specific care instructions verified; obtain final care guidance before listing.
journal.notes: Recorded dimensions and page count match. Forest green is proposed printed cover artwork, not a verified green stock blank. Check full-cover template, spine, bleed, barcode clearance and cream artwork contrast. JournalBook 5.5 × 8.5 in / 80 pages is a different product and must not replace this match.

throw.name: Embroidered Premium Sherpa Blanket | Port Authority BP40
throw.material: 100% polyester fleece face / 100% polyester sherpa reverse
throw.care: Blanket-specific embroidered care not verified; obtain manufacturer label. Do not reuse sublimated blanket care.
throw.notes: Format and corner embroidery are plausible, but reviewed color names do not establish a cream or forest-green face. Inspect both sides and placement before approving any substitution.
